Oboe is consumed as the official Google Maven Prefab AAR:
`com.google.oboe:oboe:1.11.0`.

Release: https://github.com/google/oboe/releases/tag/1.11.0
License: Apache License 2.0, copied from the release's `LICENSE` file here.
